title: Sean McVay hoping Puka Nacua will 'learn and grow' after off-field incidents

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Sean McVay hoping Puka Nacua will 'learn and grow' after off-field incidents
sources.description: Rams coach Sean McVay hopes Puka Nacua will "learn and grow" in the wake of a woman filing a lawsuit against the wide receiver as contract talks loom.
